comment: Microarchitecture description of the single-cycle core for error injection: the unit results that enter the result multiplexers, with the instructions that select each, and the architectural observation boundary.

control_sites.name: address_adder
control_sites.comment: Never a candidate: forms load and store addresses. Used only as a negative control of the proof.

observation_boundary.comment: The memory interface; the register file is state and is covered by the sequential proof. Address and write data of the data memory are observed in the cycles in which a request is made.
